title: RAG Builder
source: AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) exam guide · Domain 3

ladders.title: RAG Builder
ladders.prompt: Order the stages from ingestion to a grounded, cited answer.

steps.label: Ingest Trusted Source Documents
steps.detail: Retrieval can only ever surface what was ingested. Source selection is a governance decision, not a plumbing one.

steps.label: Clean, Split, and Attach Metadata
steps.detail: Chunking decides what a retrievable unit is; metadata is what later makes filtering and attribution possible.

steps.label: Create Embeddings for Each Chunk
steps.detail: Text becomes vectors. The embedding model chosen here constrains everything the retriever can distinguish.

steps.label: Store Chunks and Vectors in an Index
steps.detail: The index makes similarity search tractable. Access controls belong here, not only at the answer.

steps.label: Embed and Interpret the User Query
steps.detail: The query is embedded by the same model as the chunks, or the two live in incomparable spaces.

steps.label: Retrieve, Filter, and Rerank Evidence
steps.detail: Recall decides whether the right passage is available at all; ranking decides whether it survives the context budget.

steps.label: Build a Prompt with Evidence and Instructions
steps.detail: The retrieved evidence is placed in the prompt with instructions on how to use it and when to refuse.

steps.label: Generate, Validate, and Cite the Grounded Answer
steps.detail: The model answers from the supplied evidence and cites it, so a reader can check rather than trust.
